facts.description:
River Green 嘉溪绿苑 is a new 36-storey luxury residence by Wing Tai Asia in prime District 9. It features 524 well-designed 1- to 4-bedroom units, just steps from Great World MRT. With Orchard, the CBD, and the Singapore River all nearby, you’re perfectly connected to everything that matters.
Enjoy direct access to Great World City for daily essentials, dining, and shopping. Families will love the location—River Valley Primary School is within 1km. Whether you’re heading to work, relaxing by the river, or dining out at Robertson Quay, life here is effortless and exciting.
Designed by a top-tier team—P&T Architects, STX Landscape Architects, L’Observatoire International (lighting), and Index Design (interiors)—River Green blends elegance with function. With 48 lifestyle facilities, lush greenery, and a focus on wellness, this is modern city living with long-term value.
Move with the city. Stay connected. Live inspired.
facts.keyPoints:
• Site sensitive design approach
• Prime location next to Great World City MRT
• E-deck berm up 5m from street level
• Units raised another 16m from e-deck level (equivalent to 5 storeys)
• Facilities befitting to the prestige of D9 development
• Unit plans are compact, functional, efficient use of space
• All units are non-PPVC with flexible internal layout
• Roof feature combined with façade lighting, Interesting architecture that enhances the city skyline
• Roof terrace with M&E lifted to optimize useable spaces with best views out
• Universal design, sustainability efforts (Greenmark Platinum, SLE - 5 Badge)
